item.title: Bulletin updated at 06:55 HKT 22/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An intense winter monsoon will continue to bring cold weather to Guangdong in the next couple of days. Under the influence of upper-air disturbances, it will still be rainy over the coast of southern China today. With the upper-air disturbances departing and the monsoon moderating gradually, the weather will improve with temperatures rising progressively over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week.

Date/Month: 22/02 (Tuesday)
Wind: North force 4 to 5, occasionally force 6 on high ground.
Weather: It will be cold. Cloudy to overcast with rain. Rain will be more frequent later.
Temp range: 9 - 11 C
R.H. range: 85 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
